headings: Advanced Reporting: We close the loop on digital and traditional media by linking ad spend to online and offline sales.
paragraphs: We are an advertising technology company. Our cloud-based demand side platform ("DSP") enables the programmatic purchase of advertising, which is the electronification of the digital advertising buying process. Programmatic advertising is rapidly taking market share from traditional ad sales channels, which require more staffing, offer less transparency, and involve higher costs to buyers.

Our DSP is used by marketers and their advertising agencies to centralize the planning, buying and measurement of their digital advertising across most channels. Through our omnichannel platform, a marketer can easily buy ads on connected TV ("CTV"), streaming audio, digital out-of-home, mobile and desktop.

Our DSP is an easy-to-use self-service platform that provides our customers with transparency and control over their advertising campaigns. Once a marketer describes their campaign objectives, they can choose to maintain hands-on control over every campaign detail or have our platform autonomously execute, optimize, and measure their advertising investments. Our platform offers customers unique visibility across a variety of inventory, allowing them to create customized audience segments and leverage our proprietary Household ID ("HHID") and strategic partner data to reach target audiences at scale. Our platform delivers a full suite of forecasting, reporting and automation that provides our customers with insights into available inventory based on the desired target audience. We offer advanced forecasting and reporting that empowers our customers with functionality designed to ensure they can accurately measure and improve their return-on-advertising spend ("ROAS") across channels.

Marketers use our platform to deliver advertising campaigns to their desired target audience across channels and formats. Through platform integrations, we offer our customers access to omnichannel advertising inventory, which refers to media available across devices, channels and formats. Our platform supports a full range of transaction types including real-time bidding, private marketplace and programmatic guaranteed, allowing customers to easily source and integrate ad inventory directly from publishers and private marketplaces.

We enable deep data access through our data integrations to authenticate user identities across a range of devices. Our HHID enables us to be the nexus point with more than 70 data partners, providing customers with deep access to data across market verticals such as automotive, entertainment, professional services, retail, consumer packaged goods, travel and tourism, and healthcare. Our HHID solution empowers marketers to reach people across their devices, whether individuals are at home or away from home, without the use of cookies. Leveraging patented technology, our HHID technology cuts through more than 1.8 billion IP addresses and other identifiers and translates them into 125 million households. Our identity graph links these households to an estimated 1 billion connected devices.

Our customers are advertising buyers including large advertising holding companies, independent advertising agencies, mid-market advertising service organizations as well as marketers that rely on our self-service platform for their programmatic ad buying needs. We are a trusted partner to our customers as exemplified by our customer satisfaction rating of over 90% in 2025 based on Viant's Annual Customer Satisfaction Survey. Many of our customers use us as their primary DSP.

Using our identity resolution capabilities led by our patented HHID and identity graph, marketers and their advertising agencies can identify targeted consumers using real-world identifiers rather than relying primarily on cookies to track users. We believe the industry is shifting to replace cookies in delivering personalized advertising, particularly for identification. Our HHID allows marketers to deliver personalized advertising while being able to accurately link ad impressions across multiple devices and to customer sales and measure the impact of their ad spend. Many of our competitors rely on cookies for the targeting and measurement of digital advertising but this technology has not been effective at accurately measuring the real impact of a marketer's ad spend on their business results. Apple's web browser, Safari, has added controls that algorithmically block or limit some cookies, and other browsers and platforms have added similar controls. This market change has created an increase in demand from marketers actively looking for platforms like ours that offer an alternative to cookie-based tracking, which we believe is strengthening our strategic position.

Programmatic advertising has proven its value to marketers and an increasing number of organizations are devoting more of their digital ad spend to it. The digital ecosystem continues to evolve and with it, programmatic advertising, creating new opportunities and needs for marketers and their agencies. The U.S. programmatic advertising market is expected to grow from $158.8 billion in 2024 to $225.3 billion in 2027, a 12% compound annual growth rate ("CAGR"), according to eMarketer, a market research company that provides insights and trends related to digital marketing, media and commerce. We focus on ad buyers and believe that our solutions will accelerate the shift of advertising budgets to programmatic advertising. Additionally, as marketers desire more control over programmatic advertising and move some functions of programmatic ad buying in-house, we have automated our platform by leveraging machine learning, automated decision-making and artificial intelligence ("AI") designed to address these needs and expand our market opportunity.

Our total revenue was $344.2 million, $289.2 million and $222.9 million for the fiscal years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023 ("fiscal year 2025", "fiscal year 2024", and "fiscal year 2023"), respectively, representing an increase of 19.0% from fiscal year 2024 to fiscal year 2025 and an increase of 29.7% from fiscal year 2023 to fiscal year 2024. We recorded net income (losses) of $24.1 million, $12.5 million and $(9.9) million, and adjusted EBITDA of $57.4 million, $44.4 million, and $29.1 million for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively.

Adjusted EBITDA is a financial measure not presented in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles in the United States of America ("GAAP"). For a definition of adjusted EBITDA, an explanation of our management's use of this measure and a reconciliation of adjusted EBITDA to our net income or net loss, see "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations—Key Operating and Financial Performance Measures—Use of Non-GAAP Financial Measures."
We believe the key industry trends shaping the advertising market include:

Advertising dollars shifting toward programmatic advertising: We believe the advertising industry is still in the early stages of a shift toward programmatic advertising. The ability to transact through real-time-bidding platforms has evolved beyond banner advertising to be used across a wide range of advertising channels and formats, including CTV, streaming audio, digital out-of-home, mobile, and desktop. U.S. programmatic advertising is experiencing a rapid increase in adoption and, according to eMarketer, is expected to grow at a 12% CAGR from 2024 to 2027, reaching $203.0 billion in 2026 and $225.3 billion by 2027. U.S. programmatic advertising is forecasted to represent 46% of total U.S. media spend by 2027, increasing from 40% in 2024. The TV industry is undergoing significant disruptions as internet-enabled CTV has become a preferred vehicle for streaming video content. CTV ad spending is expected to reach $38.0 billion in 2026, with 92% of those dollars going to video ads. CTV ad spending is expected to continue double-digit annual growth rates and surpass traditional TV ad spending in 2029 and reach $52.5 billion. The amount of CTV users in the U.S. is forecasted to increase from approximately 235 million, or 70% of the U.S. population, in 2024 to approximately 248 million, or 73%% of the U.S. population, in 2027, according to eMarketer. CTV also provides a number of benefits to advertisers, including more accurate control of scale, addressability and measurement. Marketers are increasingly investing in CTV as more inventory becomes available. According to eMarketer, 89% of CTV ad spend was transacted programmatically in 2025. The share of programmatic advertising is expected to increase to 93% in 2027.

Strong marketer demand for ROAS measurement across most channels: Marketers are looking for a centralized view of their customers, while connecting online and offline purchases to accurately measure ROAS. ROAS is a critical metric for marketing campaigns. Insights from ROAS across all campaigns inform marketers about the value of their investment across all media spend in near real-time. Hence, marketers seek tools to track their ROAS across channels. We believe customers using our platform and HHID are able to get a more accurate measurement of ROAS as compared to cookie-based platforms, especially in naturally cookieless environments such as CTV.

Demand for scaled people-based platforms: Advertising has become more data driven, and marketers need to be able to target audiences at the individual and household level while respecting consumer privacy. Internet advertisers in the past have capitalized on device-based identifiers such as cookies to gain insights into users and ad performance. However, technical changes and increased privacy concerns are causing marketers to reduce their reliance on vendors and platforms that primarily utilize cookies for device identification. In today's connected world, marketers need to be able to identify their customers and connect with them across most channels, devices and formats. This, we believe, will drive an industry shift away from cookie-based DSPs to scaled people-based DSPs.

headings: Risks Related to Our Business and Operations
Our success and revenue growth are dependent on enhancing and improving our platform and effectively educating and training our customers on how to make full use of our platform.
We may not realize the expected benefits of an industry shift away from cookie-based consumer tracking.
If we fail to innovate and make the right investment decisions in our offerings and platform, we may not attract and retain customers, and our revenue and results of operations may decline.
The market for programmatic advertising is evolving. If this market develops slower or differently than we expect, our business, operating results and financial condition would be adversely affected.
We are subject to payment-related risks and if our customers do not pay or dispute their invoices, our business, operating results and financial condition may be adversely affected.
If our access to advertising inventory is diminished or fails to grow, our revenue could decline, and our growth could be impeded.
If our access to data is diminished, the effectiveness of our platform would be decreased, which could harm our operating results and financial condition.

If we do not effectively grow and train our sales and support teams, we may be unable to add new customers or increase usage of our platform by our existing customers and our business will be adversely affected.
We face potential liability and harm to our business based on the human factor of inputting information into our platform.
Future acquisitions, strategic investments or alliances could disrupt our business and harm our business, operating results and financial condition.

Our future success depends on the continuing efforts of our key employees, including Tim Vanderhook and Chris Vanderhook, and our ability to attract, hire, retain and motivate highly skilled employees in the future.
We face liabilities arising out of our ownership and operation of Myspace.com.
The market in which we participate is intensely competitive, and we may not be able to compete successfully with our current or future competitors.
paragraphs: Investing in our Class A common stock involves a high degree of risk. You should carefully consider the following risks and uncertainties described below, together with all other information contained in this Annual Report, including our consolidated financial statements and the related notes included elsewhere in this Annual Report, and in our other public filings with the SEC. The occurrence of any of the following risks, as well as any risks or uncertainties not currently known to us or that we currently do not believe to be material, could materially and adversely affect our business, prospects, financial condition, results of operations and cash flow, in which case, the trading price of our Class A common stock could decline and you could lose all or part of your investment.

Our success is dependent on our ability to enhance and improve our offerings and platform, build our brand, scale our technology capabilities, add functionality to and improve the performance of our DSP, and address technological and industry advancements, including the use of AI, to increase our customers' usage of our platform and add new customers. Our contracts and relationships with customers generally do not include long-term or exclusive obligations requiring them to use our platform or maintain or increase their use of our platform. Our customers typically have relationships with numerous providers and can use both our platform and those of our competitors without incurring significant costs or disruption. Our customers may also choose to decrease their overall advertising spend for any reason, including if they do not believe they are receiving a sufficient return on advertising spend. Accordingly, we must continually work to win new customers and retain existing customers, increase their usage of our platform and capture a larger share of their advertising spend. For those customers utilizing our self-service or AI capabilities, we may not be successful at educating and training customers, particularly our newer customers, on how to use our platform, in order for our customers to get the most benefit from our platform and increase their usage. If these efforts are unsuccessful or customers decide not to continue to maintain or increase their usage of our platform for any other reason, or if we fail to attract new customers, our revenue could fail to grow or decline, which would materially and adversely harm our business, operating results and financial condition. If customers representing a significant portion of our business decide to materially reduce their use of our platform or cease using our platform altogether, our revenue could be significantly reduced, which could have a material adverse effect on our business, operating results and financial condition. We may not be able to replace customers who decrease or cease their usage of our platform with new customers that will use our platform to the same extent or at all.

We expect to benefit relative to others in our industry from marketers reducing their reliance on vendors and advertising technology platforms that utilize third-party cookies for tracking. However, the shift away from cookie-based consumer tracking may not happen as rapidly as or to the degree that we expect, and our competitors may adapt their services. Additionally, even as this shift occurs, we may not be as successful in growing our business and increasing our revenue as we expect. For example, marketers may not shift their business away from our competitors if our competitors are successful in developing alternative products or services that are not significantly reliant on the cookie-based framework, which could harm our business.

Our industry is subject to rapid and frequent changes in technology, evolving customer needs and the frequent introduction by our competitors of new and enhanced offerings. We must regularly make investment decisions regarding offerings and technology to maintain the technological competitiveness of our products and services and meet customer demand and evolving industry standards. The complexity and uncertainty regarding the development of new technologies and the extent and timing of market acceptance of innovative products and services create difficulties in maintaining this competitiveness. The success of any enhancement or new solution depends on many factors, including timely completion, adequate quality testing, appropriate introduction and market acceptance. Without the timely introduction of new products, services and enhancements, including those leveraging AI and machine learning, our offerings could become technologically or commercially obsolete over time, in which case our revenue and operating results would suffer. In addition, such new products, services or enhancements may create new, or exacerbate existing, technological, security, legal and other challenges, could cause unintended consequences, and may not perform as intended. If new or existing competitors replicate our offerings or have more attractive offerings, we may lose customers or customers may decrease their use of our platform. New customer demands, superior competitive offerings or new industry standards could require us to make unanticipated and costly changes to our platform or business model. In addition, as we develop and introduce new products and services, including those incorporating or utilizing AI and machine learning and new processing of information, they may raise new, or heighten existing, technological, security, legal and other risks and challenges, that may cause unintended consequences and may not function properly or may be misused by our customers.

If we fail to enhance our current products and services or fail to develop new products to adapt to our rapidly changing industry and applicable laws, regulations, and other legal obligations, or to evolving customer needs, demand for our platform could decrease and our business, operating results and financial condition may be adversely affected.

We derive revenue from the programmatic purchase of advertising on our platform. We expect that programmatic ad buying will continue to be our primary source of revenue for the foreseeable future, and that our revenue growth will largely depend on increasing our customers' usage of our platform. While the market for programmatic ad buying for desktop and mobile ads is relatively established, the market in other channels is still emerging, and our current and potential customers may not shift quickly enough to programmatic ad buying from other buying methods, which could reduce our growth potential. If the market for programmatic ad buying deteriorates or develops more slowly than we expect, it could reduce demand for our platform, and our business, growth prospects and financial condition would be adversely affected.

paragraphs: The following Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations of Viant Technology Inc. and its subsidiaries ("Viant," "we," "us," "our" or the "Company") should be read in conjunction with, and is qualified in its entirety by reference to, our consolidated financial statements and the related notes included within this Annual Report on Form 10-K ("Annual Report"). In addition to historical financial information, the following discussion and analysis contains forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties which could cause our actual results to differ materially from those anticipated in these forward-looking statements, including, but not limited to, the risks and uncertainties discussed under the headings "Special Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements" and "Risk Factors" and discussed elsewhere in this Annual Report. Additionally, our historical results are not necessarily indicative of the results that may be expected for any period in the future.

The following discusses our financial condition and results of operations for our fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 compared to our fiscal year ended December 31, 2024 as well as discussions of our financial condition and results of operations for our fiscal year ended December 31, 2024 compared to our fiscal year ended December 31, 2023.

We are an advertising technology company. Our cloud-based demand side platform ("DSP") enables the programmatic purchase of advertising, which is the electronification of the digital advertising buying process. Programmatic advertising is rapidly taking market share from traditional ad sales channels, which require more staffing, offer less transparency and involve higher costs to buyers.

Our DSP is used by marketers and their advertising agencies to centralize the planning, buying and measurement of their digital advertising across most channels. Through our omnichannel platform, a marketer can easily buy ads on connected TV ("CTV"), streaming audio, digital out-of-home, mobile and desktop.

Additionally, our artificial intelligence product suite, ViantAI, will be the foundational component of our long-term vision for autonomous advertising. We expect it to power every stage of the programmatic advertising lifecycle and create the most efficient and cost-effective experience for our customers. Our ViantAI suite currently includes AI Planning, which enables media planners to design high-impact campaigns in seconds, AI Bidding, which optimizes inventory costs by lowering the effective cost per mille ("eCPM") through automated bid adjustments, AI Measurement and Analysis, which provides accessible measurement and insights via a user-friendly chat interface, and recently released AI Decisioning, which automates planning, execution, measurement and dynamic optimization of campaigns in real-time. The launch of AI Decisioning was accompanied by the introduction of Outcomes, our autonomous advertising performance solution that utilizes each of the four phases of ViantAI, and various signals within our intelligence layer, to build and execute campaigns designed to deliver an optimal outcome.

Our DSP is an easy-to-use self-service platform that provides our customers with transparency and control over their advertising campaigns. Customers can choose to maintain hands-on control over every campaign detail or have our platform autonomously execute, optimize, and measure their advertising investments. Our platform offers customers unique visibility across a variety of inventory, allowing them to create customized audience segments and leverage our addressability solutions, Household ID ("HHID") and IRIS_ID, and strategic partner data to reach target audiences at scale. Our platform delivers a full suite of forecasting, reporting and built-in automation that provides our customers with insights into available inventory based on the desired target audience. We offer advanced forecasting and reporting that empowers our customers with functionality designed to ensure they can accurately measure and improve their return on advertising spend across channels, a feature we believe helps us grow our customer base as more customers recognize its benefits.

We generate revenue by charging platform fees and service fees pursuant to agreements that enable a wide variety of marketers and their agencies to select the mix of pricing and service options that suits their unique business and advertising budget.

These options consist of a percentage of spend pricing option and a fixed cost per mille ("CPM") pricing option. Customers who prefer to use our platform on a self-service basis to execute their advertising campaigns enter into master service agreements ("MSAs") with us, and we generate revenue under these arrangements by charging a platform fee that is primarily a percentage of spend. Customers who prefer to use our fixed CPM pricing option enter into insertion order ("IO") arrangements with us, and we generate revenue by charging these customers a platform fee at a price for every 1,000 impressions an ad receives. We also offer additional service options to customers accessing our platform under an MSA or an IO, which enables them to use our services to aid them in data management, media execution and advanced reporting. When customers utilize these service options, we generate revenue by charging a service fee separate from the platform fee.

We believe that offering a mix of pricing and service options provides greater flexibility and access to our platform for marketers and their advertising agencies seeking to plan, buy and measure programmatic campaigns.

paragraphs: 本公司為廣告科技公司。我們的雲端基礎需求端平台（"DSP"）使廣告買家能透過程式化方式進行廣告購買，這即是數位廣告買賣流程的電子化。程式化廣告正迅速從傳統廣告銷售渠道奪取市場份額，而傳統渠道需要更多人力、透明度較低，且對買家而言成本較高。
我們的 DSP 用於廣告主及其廣告代理商，以集中規劃、購買及衡量其在大多數渠道的數位廣告。透過我們的全通路平台，廣告主可輕鬆在串流電視（"CTV"）、串流音訊、數位戶外、行動裝置及桌面裝置上購買廣告。

我們的 DSP 是一個易於使用的自服務平台，為客戶提供對其廣告活動的透明度與控制力。一旦廣告主說明其活動目標，他們可選擇親自掌控每項活動細節，或讓平台自動執行、優化並衡量其廣告投資。我們的平台為客戶提供跨多種存貨的獨特可視性，使其能建立客製化受眾區塊，並利用我們的專有家庭識別碼（"HHID"）與策略性合作夥伴資料，以規模方式觸及目標受眾。我們的平台提供完整的預測、報告與自動化功能，使客戶能根據所選目標受眾，瞭解可用存貨情況。我們提供先進的預測與報告功能，使客戶能使用設計用以確保其能準確衡量並改善廣告支出回報率（"ROAS"）的功能。
廣告主透過我們的平台，將廣告活動投放至其目標受眾，跨多種渠道與格式。透過平台整合，我們為客戶提供跨多種裝置、渠道與格式的全通路廣告存貨存取。我們的平台支援多種交易類型，包括實時競標、私有市場與程式化保證交易，使客戶能輕鬆從發行商與私有市場直接取得並整合廣告存貨。

我們透過資料整合提供深度資料存取，以驗證用戶身分於多種裝置之間。我們的 HHID 讓我們成為與超過 70 個資料夥伴的樞紐點，為客戶提供跨產業垂直領域的深度資料存取，例如汽車、娛樂、專業服務、零售、消費性包裝商品、旅遊與觀光，以及醫療保健。我們的 HHID 解決方案讓行銷人員能夠在用戶無論在家或在外的裝置上接觸到人們，而無需使用 Cookie。透過專利技術，我們的 HHID 技術穿透超過 1.8 十億 IP 位址和其他識別碼，並將其轉換為 125 百萬戶家庭。我們的身分圖譜將這些戶家庭連結至估計 1 十億臺連線裝置。
我們的客戶為廣告買家，包括大型廣告控股公司、獨立廣告代理商、中型市場廣告服務機構以及依賴我們自服務平台進行程式化廣告購買需求的廣告主。我們是客戶的可靠合作夥伴，如 2025 年根據 Viant 年度客戶滿意度調查所顯示的客戶滿意度評分超過 90%。許多客戶將我們用作其主要 DSP。

透過我們由專利 HHID 及身分圖譜領導的身分解析能力，廣告主及其廣告代理商可使用真實世界識別碼識別目標消費者，而非主要依賴 Cookie 來追蹤用戶。我們認為產業正在轉向以取代 Cookie 來提供個性化廣告，特別是在識別方面。我們的 HHID 使廣告主能投放個性化廣告，同時能準確連結廣告展示至多種裝置及客戶銷售，並衡量其廣告支出的影響。許多競爭對手依賴 Cookie 來進行數位廣告的目標設定與衡量，但此技術在準確衡量廣告主的廣告支出對其業務成果的實際影響方面並未有效。蘋果公司的網頁瀏覽器 Safari 已加入控制功能，可演算法性地阻擋或限制部分 Cookie，其他瀏覽器與平台也加入了類似控制功能。此市場變動已促使廣告主積極尋找如我們這類提供替代 Cookie 跟蹤方案的平台，我們認為這強化了我們的戰略地位。

程式化廣告已證明其對行銷人員的價值，且越來越多的機構正將更多數位廣告支出投入此領域。數位生態系統持續進化，程式化廣告亦隨之發展，為行銷人員及其代理商創造新的機會與需求。根據市場研究公司 eMarketer 的數據，美國程式化廣告市場預計將從 2024 年的 158.8 十億美元成長至 2027 年的 225.3 十億美元，年複合成長率（"CAGR"）為 12%。我們專注於廣告買家，並相信我們的解決方案將加速廣告預算向程式化廣告的轉移。此外，隨著行銷人員希望對程式化廣告擁有更多控制權，並將部分程式化廣告採購功能內移，我們已透過機械學習、自動決策及人工智慧（"AI"）自動化我們的平台，以應對這些需求並擴大我們的市場機會。

本公司總營業收入為 344.2 百萬美元、289.2 百萬美元及 222.9 百萬美元，分別為 2025 年財務年度、2024 年財務年度及 2023 年財務年度（"2025 財務年度"、"2024 財務年度"及"2023 財務年度"），相較 2024 財務年度至 2025 財務年度成長 19.0%，相較 2023 財務年度至 2024 財務年度成長 29.7%。本公司於 2025 年 12 月 31 日財務年度、2024 年 12 月 31 日財務年度及 2023 年 12 月 31 日財務年度分別錄得淨收入（損失）為 24.1 百萬美元、12.5 百萬美元及（9.9）百萬美元，以及調整後營運資金為 57.4 百萬美元、44.4 百萬美元及 29.1 百萬美元。
調整後營運資金為一財務指標，並非依美國通用會計準則（"GAAP"）呈列。有關調整後營運資金之定義、本公司管理層使用此指標之說明，以及調整後營運資金與本公司淨收入或淨損失之對應關係，請參閱 "管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析—關鍵營運與財務表現指標—非 GAAP 財務指標之使用"。
本公司認為影響廣告市場之關鍵產業趨勢包括：

廣告金額轉向程式化廣告：本公司認為廣告產業仍處於向程式化廣告轉變之初期階段。透過即時競標平台進行交易之能力已從橫幅廣告擴展至廣泛應用於各種廣告頻道與格式，包括串流電視（CTV）、串流音訊、數位戶外、行動裝置及桌面。美國程式化廣告正經歷快速的採用成長，根據 eMarketer 的預測，從 2024 年至 2027 年將以 12% 的年複合成長率成長，於 2026 年達到 203.0 十億美元，於 2027 年達到 225.3 十億美元。根據 eMarketer 的預測，到 2027 年，美國程式化廣告將佔美國總媒體支出的 46%，較 2024 年的 40% 增加。電視產業正經歷重大變革，因串流電視（CTV）已成為流媒體視訊內容的首選載具。CTV 廣告支出預計於 2026 年達到 38.0 十億美元，其中 92% 的金額將用於視訊廣告。CTV 廣告支出預計將持續雙位數的年成長率，並在 2029 年超越傳統電視廣告支出，達到 52.5 十億美元。根據 eMarketer 的預測，美國 CTV 使用者人數預計將從 2024 年約 235 百萬人（佔美國人口的 70%）增加至 2027 年約 248 百萬人（佔美國人口的 73%）。CTV 還為廣告商提供了許多優勢，包括更精準的規模控制、可達性及測量。行銷人員正 increasingly 投資 CTV，因更多廣告資源可供使用。根據 eMarketer 的預測，2025 年 89% 的 CTV 廣告支出透過程式化方式進行交易。預計到 2027 年，程式化廣告的佔比將增加至 93%。

行銷人員對跨多個頻道的 ROAS 測量需求強勁：行銷人員希望獲得對客戶的集中視圖，同時將線上與線下購買連結，以準確測量 ROAS。ROAS 是行銷活動的關鍵指標。來自各個活動的 ROAS 資訊可讓行銷人員在近乎即時的狀態下了解其投資在各個媒體支出中的價值。因此，行銷人員尋求工具以跨頻道追蹤其 ROAS。本公司認為使用本公司平台及 HHID 的客戶，相比基於 Cookie 的平台，能夠更準確地測量 ROAS，尤其是在自然無 Cookie 環境（如 CTV）中。

對可擴展的基於人際關係的平台需求增加：廣告已變得更加數據驅動，行銷人員需要能夠在個體及家庭層面進行目標投放，同時尊重消費者隱私。過去，網際網路廣告商已利用基於裝置的識別符（如 Cookie）來獲取用戶及廣告表現的洞察。然而，技術變更及隱私關注的增加，導致行銷人員減少對主要使用 Cookie 進行裝置識別的供應商及平台的依賴。在當前的連網世界中，行銷人員需要能夠識別其客戶並在大多數頻道、裝置及格式中與其互動。我們認為，這將推動產業從基於 Cookie 的 DSP 轉向可擴展的基於人際關係的 DSP。

paragraphs: 下列為本公司管理層對財務狀況及營運成果之討論與分析，應與本公司合併財務報表及相關附註一併閱讀，並完全依賴於本年度10-K申報表（"年度報告"）之內容。除歷史財務資訊外，下列討論與分析包含前瞻性陳述，涉及風險與不確定性，可能導致本公司實際結果與這些前瞻性陳述所預期的結果有重大差異，包括但不限於"前瞻性陳述特別說明"及"風險因素"等標題下所討論的風險與不確定性，以及本年度報告其他部分所討論的風險與不確定性。此外，本公司歷史結果並不一定代表未來任何期間的結果。
下列討論為本公司財務狀況及營運成果於財務年度終結為2025年12月31日，與財務年度終結為2024年12月31日之比較，以及本公司財務狀況及營運成果於財務年度終結為2024年12月31日，與財務年度終結為2023年12月31日之比較。
本公司為廣告科技公司。本公司基於雲端的廣告需求端平台（"DSP"）使廣告買家能透過程式化方式進行廣告購買，即數位廣告買賣流程的電子化。程式化廣告正迅速從傳統廣告銷售管道奪取市場份額，而傳統廣告銷售管道需要更多人力，透明度較低，且對買家而言成本較高。
本公司DSP被廣告主及其廣告代理商用來集中規劃、購買與衡量其數位廣告，涵蓋大多數廣告渠道。透過本公司全渠道平台，廣告主可輕鬆在串流電視（"CTV"）、串流音訊、數位戶外、行動裝置與桌面裝置上購買廣告。

此外，本公司人工智慧產品組合ViantAI將成為本公司長期自動化廣告願景的基礎零組件。我們預期其能驅動程式化廣告生命週期的每一個階段，並為客戶創造最有效率且成本效益最高的體驗。本公司ViantAI組合目前包含AI規劃，使媒體規劃者能在數秒內設計高影響力的廣告活動、AI競標，透過自動化競標調整來降低有效每千次展示成本（"eCPM"），AI衡量與分析，透過使用者友善的聊天介面提供易於使用的衡量與洞察，以及最近推出的AI決策，可自動化規劃、執行、衡量與廣告活動的動態最佳化。AI決策的推出同時伴隨著Outcomes的推出，這是本公司自動化廣告績效解決方案，利用ViantAI的四個階段以及我們智慧層內的各種信號，來建立並執行旨在達成最佳結果的廣告活動。

本公司DSP為一個易於使用的自服務平台，使客戶能對其廣告活動擁有透明度與控制權。客戶可選擇親自掌控每一個廣告活動細節，或讓平台自動執行、最佳化與衡量其廣告投資。本公司平台為客戶提供跨多種存貨的獨特可視性，使他們能建立客製化受眾羣組，並利用我們的可達性解決方案，即家庭識別碼（"HHID"）與IRIS_ID，以及策略性合作夥伴資料，來大規模接觸目標受眾。本公司平台提供完整的預測、報告與內建自動化功能，使客戶能根據所選目標受眾，獲得可用存貨的洞察。我們提供先進的預測與報告功能，使客戶能使用設計用以準確衡量並改善其廣告支出回報率的功能，我們相信此功能有助於我們擴大客戶羣，因為越來越多客戶認同其效益。
本公司透過收取平台費用與服務費用產生收入，根據協議，使廣範圍的廣告主及其代理商能選擇適合其獨特業務與廣告預算的價格與服務選項組合。
我們認為提供多樣化的定價與服務選項，可為行銷人員及其廣告代理商在規劃、購買及衡量程式化廣告活動時，提供更大的靈活性與使用我們平台的機會。

headings: 與本公司業務及營運相關之風險
本公司之成功與營業收入成長取決於提升與改善我們之平台，並有效教育與培訓客戶如何充分運用我們之平台。
我們可能無法實現產業從基於Cookie之消費者追蹤轉移所預期之效益。
若我們未能創新並在產品與平台做出正確之投資決策，我們可能無法吸引與留住客戶，且本公司之營業收入與營運結果可能下降。
程序化廣告市場正在演進。若此市場發展速度或方式與我們預期不同，將對本公司業務、營運結果與財務狀況產生不利影響。
本公司面臨與付款相關之風險，若客戶未付款或爭議其發票，將對本公司業務、營運結果與財務狀況產生不利影響。
若本公司對廣告存貨之存取減少或未能成長，將導致營業收入下降，且成長可能受阻。
若本公司對數據之存取減少，將降低平台之效益，這可能對營運結果與財務狀況造成損害。
若我們無法有效拓展並培訓銷售及支援團隊，則可能無法增加新客戶或提高現有客戶對我們平台的使用率，進而對我們的業務造成不利影響。
我們面臨因將資訊輸入至我們平台的「人為因素」而產生的潛在責任與對業務的損害。
未來的併購、戰略投資或聯盟可能會干擾我們的業務，並對我們的業務、營運成果與財務狀況造成損害。
我們未來的成功取決於關鍵員工持續的努力，包括 Tim Vanderhook 與 Chris Vanderhook，以及我們未來吸引、僱用、留住並激勵高技能員工的能力。
我們因擁有並運作 Myspace.com 而面臨責任問題。
我們所參與的市場競爭激烈，我們可能無法成功與現有或未來的競爭對手競爭。
paragraphs: 投資本公司 A 級普通股涉及高度風險。您應仔細考慮下列風險與不確定性，並與本年度年報中包含的所有資訊一併考量，包括我們合併財務報表及相關附註，以及其他向 SEC 提交的公開檔。上述任何風險的發生，以及任何目前未為本公司所知或本公司目前認為非重大之風險或不確定性，均可能對本公司業務、前景、財務狀況、營運成果與現金流造成重大且不利的影響，進而使本公司 A 級普通股的交易價格下跌，您可能損失全部或部分投資。

本公司之成功取決於本公司能提升與改善我們的產品與平台、建立品牌、擴大技術能力、增加功能並改善我們的 DSP 表現，以及應對科技與產業的進步，包括 AI 的應用，以增加客戶使用我們平台的頻率並增加新客戶。我們與客戶的契約與關係通常不包含長期或獨佔義務，要求他們使用我們的平台或維持或增加使用我們的平台。客戶通常與多個供應商有關係，可以同時使用我們的平台與我們競爭對手的平台，而不會產生顯著的成本或中斷。客戶也可能因任何原因減少總體廣告支出，包括他們認為廣告支出未能獲得足夠回報。因此，我們必須持續努力爭取新客戶與留住現有客戶，增加他們使用我們平台的頻率，並佔據他們廣告支出的更大比例。對於使用我們自服務或 AI 功能的客戶，我們可能無法成功教育與培訓客戶，特別是較新的客戶，如何使用我們的平台，以便客戶能從我們的平台獲得最大效益並增加使用頻率。如果這些努力失敗或客戶因任何原因決定不再維持或增加使用我們的平台，或我們無法吸引新客戶，則我們的收入可能無法成長或下降，這將對本公司業務、營運成果與財務狀況造成重大且不利的影響。如果代表本公司業務重大部分的客戶決定大幅減少使用我們的平台或完全停止使用我們的平台，則我們的收入可能大幅減少，這可能對本公司業務、營運成果與財務狀況造成重大不利影響。我們可能無法以同樣程度或完全取代減少或停止使用我們平台的客戶，以新客戶取代。

我們預期會因行銷者減少對使用第三方 Cookie 進行追蹤的供應商與廣告科技平台的依賴而相對於產業內其他公司受益。然而，從基於 Cookie 的消費者追蹤轉移的過程可能不會如我們預期般快速或程度，且我們的競爭對手可能適應其服務。此外，即使這種轉移發生，我們可能無法如預期般成功成長業務與增加收入。例如，行銷者可能不會轉移其業務至我們的競爭對手，如果我們的競爭對手成功開發出不顯著依賴基於 Cookie 框架的替代產品或服務，這可能會對我們的業務造成傷害。

我們的產業受到科技快速與頻繁的變更、演進的客戶需求以及競爭對手頻繁推出新產品與增強功能的影響。我們必須定期做出投資決策，以維持我們產品與服務的科技競爭力，並符合客戶需求與產業標準。新科技的發展複雜性與不確定性，以及創新產品與服務的市場接受度與時間點，使維持競爭力變得困難。任何增強或新解決方案的成功取決於許多因素，包括及時完成、充分的品質測試、適當的推出與市場接受度。若未能及時推出新產品、服務與增強功能，包括那些運用 AI 與機器學習的產品，我們的產品與服務可能隨時間變得科技或商業上過時，進而使我們的收入與營運成果受損。此外，這些新產品、服務或增強功能可能產生新的，或加劇現有的，科技、安全、法律及其他挑戰，可能導致未預期的後果，且可能無法如預期般運作。如果新或現有的競爭對手複製我們的產品與服務，或擁有更具吸引力的產品與服務，我們可能失去客戶，或客戶可能減少使用我們的平台。新的客戶需求、優越的競爭產品或新的產業標準可能要求我們對平台或商業模式做出未預期且成本高昂的改變。此外，當我們開發並推出新產品與服務，包括那些整合或運用 AI 與機器學習以及新資訊處理方式的產品與服務時，可能產生新的，或加劇現有的，科技、安全、法律及其他風險與挑戰，可能導致未預期的後果，且可能無法正常運作，或被客戶誤用。
如果我們未能提升現有產品與服務，或未能開發新產品以適應我們快速變化的產業與適用法律、法規及其他法律義務，或未能適應演進中的客戶需求，則對我們平台的需求可能減少，進而對本公司業務、營運成果與財務狀況造成不利影響。

我們的收入來自於我們平台上的程序化廣告購買。我們預期程序化廣告購買將在可預見的未來繼續成為我們的主要收入來源，且我們的收入成長將 largely 取決於增加客戶使用我們平台的頻率。雖然桌面與行動廣告的程序化廣告購買市場相對成熟，但其他渠道的市場仍在發展中，目前與潛在客戶可能無法迅速轉向程序化廣告購買，這可能減少我們的成長潛力。如果程序化廣告購買市場惡化或發展速度慢於我們預期，則可能減少對我們平台的需求，進而對本公司業務、成長潛力與財務狀況造成不利影響。
